goal: Keep the primary uv-run DC-Agent runtime and lightweight observability helpers executable, while keeping the optional Docker compatibility path from failing when CI or operators use it.

acceptance_criteria.description: The optional Docker image declares a healthcheck against the unauthenticated /api/chat/health endpoint using tools available in the runtime image.
The optional Docker build context includes the built dashboard dist artifact while continuing to exclude local runtime data.

DC-Agent observability helpers import and run without optional tracing or metrics packages, and main.py initializes them explicitly on the primary uv-run path instead of relying on runtime monkeypatching.

runtime_policy.docker_role: optional CI/operator compatibility path, not the normal local runtime
runtime_policy.runtime_data_policy: exclude data/* except data/dist from Docker build context

manual: uv run ruff check dc_logging.py dc_metrics.py dc_tracing.py tests/test_container_observability.py tests/harness/test_container_observability_contract.py
